notes.title: Minimum system requirements
notes.notes:
A little archaeological research and we found the original box (the first edition of 1999). There is also a minimum system requirements.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29350716/c169fd39035a2ea21919d01338911186815f348c.jpg[/img]

Intel Pentium 90 MHz processor or compatible, video card with 1 MB of video memory and 16MB of RAM.

[b]We believe your game PC will fulfill these strict requirements without any problems.[/b]
